title: LB Semicon
summary: Korean OSAT specialising in bumping, wafer-level packaging and test.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

LB Semicon provides bumping, wafer-level packaging and test for Korean fabless and memory customers. Its scale is modest, so utilisation on a few programmes moves revenue materially. The company has been adding capacity for advanced packages as domestic customers move to finer bump pitch.

Technology Exposure

  • Bumping and wafer-level packaging
  • Test services
  • Advanced package development

What To Watch

  • Customer programme ramps
  • Utilisation and pricing
  • Capex funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
